summary: Frontend-only validation of the new three.js HeroRobot joint-animation hero. Canvas mounts, rigged GLB loads, per-joint articulation runs ~10.5s loop while camera & base stay fixed, click opens case-study modal, drag orbits without opening, animation pauses when hero is scrolled out of view and resumes on scroll-in, prefers-reduced-motion yields identical static frames, mobile 375 has no horizontal overflow, and there are no console errors (only benign three.js/PostHog warnings).

verifications.interpretation: Non-zero global diff but base-strip diff = 0 confirms JOINT articulation, not whole-model turntable spin (base puck pixels are static).
console_warnings_benign: THREE.WebGLShadowMap: PCFSoftShadowMap has been deprecated. Using PCFShadowMap instead.
ReadPixels GPU stall (caused by test instrumentation)

action_items: Optional: three.js deprecation warning 'PCFSoftShadowMap has been deprecated. Using PCFShadowMap instead.' — consider switching to THREE.PCFShadowMap or VSMShadowMap in HeroRobot.jsx to silence the warning. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: HeroRobot.jsx correctly disposes renderer, geometries, materials, controls, observers and listeners on unmount — good cleanup.
onClickCapture drag-guard uses stopPropagation+preventDefault and resets dragged flag — robust pattern.
poseAt uses a modulo-wrapped keyframe search with cosine ease — seamless loop (first & last keyframe identical), confirmed visually and by returning signature trend.
IntersectionObserver + visibilitychange gates the rAF loop correctly (verified: 0 diff while scrolled out, non-zero on return).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hero is now a custom three.js renderer in HeroRobot.jsx. data-testid='hero-centerpiece' is the container; query 'canvas' inside it. Click-to-open target is 'hero-featured-card'. To distinguish joint motion from camera motion, compare a 12%-tall bottom strip of the canvas (base puck) over a 2.5s window — it should be ~0 while the full-frame diff is non-zero. Pause behavior is driven by IntersectionObserver + document.hidden. Reduced-motion branch renders exactly once in home pose and listens only to controls 'change'.
